name: documentary_render
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,base64
from pathlib import Path
for name,page in [('cover',2),('cover',6),('mis',10),('cover-companion',12)]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1400','-singlefile','-png',str(Path('inputs/sources',name+'.pdf'))],capture_output=True,timeout=25);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),f'figures/{name}-p{page}.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0,w.stderr
 print(name,page,len(r.stdout))
